reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a sovereign guaranteed loan to the National Electric Power Company (NEPCO) to finance the construction and upgrade of three substations (Abdoun New Substation 132/33 kV), Irbid North-West Substation 132/33 kV, and expansion of the existing Amman North Substation (132/33 kV), which will strengthen the grid's ability to integrate additional renewable energy sources, reduce energy curtailment, and lower system losses. The proceeds of the Bank's loan will be used by NEPCO to finance the construction and upgrade of three substations (Abdoun New Substation 132/33 kV), Irbid North-West Substation 132/33 kV, and expansion of the existing Amman North Substation (132/33 kV). The Project will help (i) improve the absorption capacity of existing and planned renewable energy projects, (ii) increase dispatching flexibility, (iii) reduce system losses; and (iv) facilitate network interconnection to neighbouring countries.
